orla.examine: Orla, who hunts the foothills and keeps the trail log at the lodge.
lines: The safe road's long, but it gets you there with both legs.
Mind the cliffs. They don't move, and that's the trouble.

wyn.examine: Keeper Wyn, who tends the three stones and says they talk back.
lines: The stones remember what the living forget.
Patience is a kind of climbing too.

aled.examine: Aled the hermit, who has lived on this ledge long enough to argue with the echoes and win sometimes.
lines: Shout, if you like. The echoes will tell you you're wrong.
Thirty winters up here. Thirty-one, if the broth keeps coming.

bryn.examine: Warden Bryn, who keeps travellers off the dangerous climb and is mostly ignored.
lines: Safe road's that way. I say it to everyone. Nobody listens.
If you go up, go up armed. If you come down, come down quieter than you went.

tamsin.examine: Tamsin the scout, watching the west where the map runs out.
lines: Smoke, some evenings, to the west.
A map's only a promise until someone walks it.
